p: he went out from thence: The faithless world by no means diminishes the virtue of Christ, but knowingly and willingly it deprives itself of the efficacy of it being offered unto them.

mighty works are wrought by his: The word signifies powers or virtues, by which are meant those wonderful works that Christ did which showed and set forth the virtue and power of his Godhead to all the world; Mt 7:22.
sisters here with us: This word is used after the manner of the Hebrews, who by brethren and sisters understand all relatives.
honour: Not only has that honour taken from him which is rightly due to him, but also has evil spoken of him and his words are misrepresented.
could there do no mighty work: That is, he would not: for we need to have faith if we are going to receive the works of God.
And he called unto him the: The disciples are prepared for that general apostleship by a special sending forth.

And commanded them that they should: Faithful pastors should not have their minds set even on things that are necessary for this life, if they might be a hindrance unto them, even if it is just a small hindrance.
sandals: The word properly signifies women's shoes.
two coats: That is they should take no change of garments with them, so that they might be lighter for this journey and travel more quickly.
there abide till ye depart from: That is, do not change your inns in this short journey.
And whosoever shall not receive you: The Lord severely avenges evil done to his servants.

anointed with oil many that were: This oil was a token and a sign of his marvellous virtue: and seeing that the gift of healing has stopped a good while since, the ceremony of anointing which is yet carried on by some is of no purpose.
And king Herod heard of him: The gospel confirms the godly and vexes the wicked.
works do shew forth themselves in: The word signifies powers, by which is meant the power of working miracles.
the prophets: Of the old prophets.
beheaded: Commanded to be beheaded.
had a quarrel against him: Sought all means to hurt him.
gladly: The tyrant was very well content to hear sentence pronounced against himself, but the seed fell upon stony places.
of the said Herodias came in: This same Herodias had the daughter by Philip, not by Herod Antipas, and Josephus called the daughter Salome.
she went forth: For women did not used to eat with men.
executioner: The word signifies one that bears a short lance, and the king's guard was so called because they bore short lances.

And he said unto them: Such as follow Christ will lack nothing, not even in the wilderness, but they will have an abundance. And how wicked a thing it is not to look during this temporal life to the hands of the one who gives everlasting life!
Shall we go and buy: This is a kind of demand and wondering, with a subtle mockery, which men commonly use when they begin to get angry and refuse to do something.
two hundred pennyworth of bread: Which is about twenty crowns, which is five pounds.
companies upon the green grass: Literally, "by banquets", after the manner of the Hebrews who have no distributive words; see Mr 6:7. Now he calls the rows of the sitters, "banquets".
ranks: The word signifies the beds in a garden, and it is literally, "by beds and beds", meaning by this that they sat down in rows one by another, as beds in a garden.

And straightway he constrained his disciples: The faithful servants of God after their little labour are subject to a great tempest which Christ, being present in power although absent in body, moderates in such a way that he brings them to a happy haven, at such time and by such means as they did not expect: A graphic image of the Church tossed to and fro in this world.
them away: His disciples.

sore amazed in themselves beyond measure: They were still so amazed when they knew that it was no spirit, that they were much more astonished than they ever were before, when they saw the wind and the sea obey his commandment.

considered not the miracle of the: Either they did not perceive, or had not well considered that miracle of the five loaves, to the point that the virtue of Christ was just as strange to them as if they had not been present at that miracle which was done just a little before.
And when they were come out: Christ being rejected in his own country, and suddenly arriving to those who had not looked for him, is received to their great profit.
him were made whole: Or the hem of his garment.
